results.text: Prediction of the optimal dose of exenatide in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus with renal impairment using physiologically based pharmacokinetic modeling. Although exenatide is approved for patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) with mild to moderate renal impairment, specific dosing guidelines for this population remain undefined.
